about_the_game:
Alchemixum is a cute lil' mixing game!
Mix elements starting from the four basic "air, earth, fire and water" and discover hundreds of combinations, and complete the Alchemixum. But not to worry, you won't be alone because you're part of a crew of space alchemists, them being:

  • Canva, a little hyperactive fairy who will help you with the game's customization, occasionally telling you jokes to lighten the mood...

  • Gaze, a studious critter who will help you progress further giving you hints towards element combinations.

  • And Figura, she will assist you with the game's settings and some more technical things, make sure to report any bugs you may encounter to her!

    FEATURES:

  • Hundreds of elements to discover

  • Several quality of life features based on feedback from other games from the same genre

  • Bees

  • Scenery mode, resize, rotate and rearrange elements to create cute little scenes or goofy lookin' monstrosities using the stickers!

  • Unlock new options of wallpaper for the mixing area and music for the game by discovering new elements!

This game is still under development so a lot might and will change!

short_description: Tasked with restoring a broken planet, you have been given the Great Alchemixum: a magical sticker book that can create and record matter instantly. With you, it can mix its stickers to make all-new elements, fill its collection, and restore the world to its former glory! You won't be alone.
